---
title: "Filtering the teacher's answers"
subtitle: "Filtered B, grounded B and filtered C"
---

{{< include /_setup.qmd >}}

**Question.** The teacher is often wrong. What does training only on its better answers buy, and can
the better answers be found without labels?

**Setup.** B's recipe on a subset of the teacher's answers:

- **Filtered B** keeps the `{python} n(teacher["variants"]["lenient"]["kept"])` that match gold under
  lenient exact. It uses labels, as a filter: the cost of the teacher's mistakes.
- **Grounded B** keeps the `{python} n(teacher["variants"]["grounded"]["kept"])` that call offered
  tools with their required arguments and whose every value is written in the query. The rule never
  reads gold: they agree with it `{python} pct(teacher["variants"]["grounded"]["lenient"])` of the
  time, against `{python} pct(teacher["variants"]["unfiltered"]["lenient"])` for all of B's data.
- **Filtered C** is C's soft targets on filtered B's rows.

::: {.facts}
```{python}
table(["Bf", "Bg", "Cf", "B"])
```
:::

```{ojs}
runs = ["Bf", "Bg", "Cf"]
```

{{< include /_run.qmd >}}

## What they show

- **Filtering against gold gains about two points, not robustly**:
  `{python} story.claim("Bf", "B", "test-clean")` against B, on fewer rows and fewer GPU-hours.
  A is still well ahead (`{python} story.claim("A", "Bf", "test-clean")`).
- **The label-free filter doesn't do the same.** Grounded B ties B
  (`{python} story.claim("Bg", "B", "test-clean")`) and trails filtered B
  (`{python} story.claim("Bf", "Bg", "test-clean")`): it gains where every value is in the query, and
  loses where a value must be worked out, since the rule dropped most of those rows.
- **On clean rows, soft targets reach unseen tools sooner, not higher.** Filtered C beats filtered B
  on BFCL at their selected checkpoints (`{python} story.claim("Cf", "Bf", "bfcl")`), but filtered B
  keeps rising, and at the end of their epochs the two are not significantly different. On
  test-clean they tie (`{python} story.claim("Cf", "Bf", "test-clean")`).

::: {.column-margin}
Filtered B: [#60](https://github.com/joaomigueloliveira/qwen-function-calling-distillation/issues/60);
grounded B: [#74](https://github.com/joaomigueloliveira/qwen-function-calling-distillation/issues/74),
[#75](https://github.com/joaomigueloliveira/qwen-function-calling-distillation/issues/75);
filtered C: [#88](https://github.com/joaomigueloliveira/qwen-function-calling-distillation/issues/88).
Why each runs: [ADR 0007](../decisions/0007-label-free-is-the-main-question.html).
:::
